findings.description: Parameters without '=' are now stored with the value True, and the key is not stripped of quotes or whitespace. get_encoding_from_headers then calls params["charset"].strip(...) on that value.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a header such as "text/html; charset" with a bare charset parameter. The parser stores params_dict['charset']=True, and get_encoding_from_headers calls True.strip(), raising AttributeError. Accessing response.encoding or response.text then crashes instead of falling back to the default encoding.
